data.title: New Account Sending Multiple Instant Payments
data.description: Detects accounts less than 30 days old that initiate multiple instant payments within a short time window. Newly opened accounts used for rapid instant-payment disbursement are a strong indicator of synthetic identity fraud or mule accounts created specifically for the monetization phase of a fraud scheme.

detection.condition: selection and filter_new_account | count() by account_id > 5

falsepositives: Newly opened business account setting up recurring vendor payments
College student opening account and paying multiple roommates for shared expenses
